d: U Mumba best UP Yoddhas by a 35-33 scoreline in match 45 of Pro Kabaddi League Season 11. Ajit Chouhan and Rohit Raghav took the defenders on a ride by scoring 16 raid points together, whereas, U Mumba's captain Sunil Kumar evaded the raiders by executing some unreal tackles to rake up 4 points. Tune into PKL Season 11 every day from 7:30 PM, only on the Star Sports Network and Disney+ hotstar. Catch all the LIVE updates on prokabaddi.com or the Pro Kabaddi Official App.
